header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

description.content: (Required) A request identifier. Providing this reference when contacting our support team will help us investigate your query.

(Required) Example: `20, 10;w=60, 20;w=3600, 200;w=86400`
The first number (20) is the limit that has been exceeded.
The remaining numbers are the limits that are in force, with 'w' meaning 'window in seconds'. In this example `20;w=3600` was exceeded. 20 calls in 3600secs (1hr)
(Required) The number of seconds until the window is reset.
